title: The Cipher of Marseille's old port
author: Coral Reyes
blurb: Ansel Delacroix, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
